## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 9, 2026 - Aug 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _samantha.ann.kenny_, Aug 9, 2026, 3/5: "I’ve used Finch for two years and it changed my life. The recent addition of branded monthly themes seemed cheap. But this week, many previously included features like daily rewards and options in the store were put behind a paywall… it’s cheap and disappointing to hit a money grab at every turn when I’m trying to survive. Previous money grabbing updates have led me to explore alternative apps and this has me looking again. If this trend continues I’ll certainly be switching. Disappointing and careless… why is everything a scam these days?"
            2. _cayers223_, Aug 9, 2026, 4/5: "I like the app but to buy Finch plus is way to expensive, the cheapest it can be is49.99."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 28, 2026 - Aug 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, May 28, 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _I hate. Finch_, Jul 9, 2026, 2/5: "Finch is bad because it I so slow"
            3. _CerberusLLC_, Aug 9, 2026, 4/5: "I love this app. It has really helped me take charge of my chores and keep myself in check despite having some chaos gremlins working in my brain. I love the creativity and collector aspect of it and it drives me to play. Biggest complaint is that it is regularly glitchy. Closes down, some of the emotion things don’t open properly, I’ve had event prize days not save properly so the prizes were doled out. Overall, minor things, but annoying enough to keep this from being a five star."
